summary.text: On February 2, 2024, Gomez emphasized responsible and ethical AI implementation to balance benefits with consumer risks. She described the February 2024 ruling covering AI-generated voices under existing robocall consent requirements as important for preventing consumer fraud. On January 14, 2026, she argued that AI leadership and other investments should be measured by people's ability to connect, participate, and benefit from the digital economy rather than infrastructure construction alone.
